primary.title: How to convert your NRO account to a resident bank account after returning to India? Process and documents required
primary.summary: NRO accounts allow NRIs to manage Indian income. Upon returning to India, NRIs must convert their NRO accounts to resident accounts by notifying their banks. Here's the entire process to do it and documents required.
